claim: User requests a simpler way to merge Excel files with different schemas without manual column mapping
paraphrased_evidence: A data analyst posted an issue requesting a built-in pandas function to automatically detect and align columns when merging multiple Excel files, describing the current manual process as error-prone and time-consuming.

claim: User reports memory issues when merging large Excel files with pandas and asks for chunked processing support
paraphrased_evidence: A data engineer described that merging 200k-row Excel files causes out-of-memory errors, and they currently have to split files manually and merge in batches, which is fragile and slow.

claim: User requests ability to merge Excel files directly from OneDrive without downloading
paraphrased_evidence: A business analyst asked for a feature in xlwings to read and merge Excel files stored in OneDrive/SharePoint, stating that the current workaround of downloading each file manually is tedious and leads to version confusion.

claim: User reports that their VBA macro for merging Excel files breaks frequently and asks for a more robust openpyxl solution
paraphrased_evidence: An operations manager described a fragile VBA macro used to merge weekly inventory files; when column order changes, the macro fails, requiring manual debugging. They want openpyxl to provide a flexible merge function that handles varying column positions.

claim: User asks for a no-code Excel merging feature in pandas, citing expensive contractor workarounds
paraphrased_evidence: A financial analyst posted a feature request for a simple, no-code way to merge Excel files with different templates, explaining that they currently pay a contractor $2,000 per month to manually align and merge subsidiary reports, which is costly and error-prone.
